content.text: Execute this full dependency chain: resolve Alice to customer_id; use that exact id to fetch orders; use the exact returned order_ids to call fetch_order_total; then check_budget with that exact total and limit 200. Independently get Berlin weather. Do not skip any stage, do not hardcode upstream values before observing them, and report the final budget and weather results.

[check_budget]
check_budget({"limit":200,"order_total":125}) => BUDGET_STATUS=WITHIN_LIMIT ORDER_TOTAL=125 LIMIT=200
